title: Happy New Year 2022!
html:
In 2021 Kamailio celebrated 20 years of development, time passed so fast! Although we couldn’t organise an in-person party with the community, we marked the event with another small online Kamailio World Conference!

The major release series 5.5.x was ready before mid of 2021, soon we will start to prepare the next one, 5.6.x, a couple of new modules and many new features are already in the development branch. Let’s hope the 2022 is the year to enter the post-pandemic era and then we will be able to meet again in person, have a celebration party for Kamailio and plan its future versions!

We wish a healthy and successful 2022 to all Kamailio friends!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!

Enjoy 2022 and stay safe!

Happy New Year!
